command.name: security key-manager onboard wrapped-nkek show
command.description: This command displays the wrapped Node Key Encryption Key (NKEK) (public and private blobs).

parameter.name: node
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the wrapped Node Key Encryption Key (public and private blobs) for the given node(s).

example.p: The following example displays the wrapped Node Key Encryption Key (public and private blobs) on all nodes.
example.screen: cluster-1::*>security key-manager onboard wrapped-nkek show Node : node1 Public NKEK BLOB : 002e0008000b00000440000000100020f4eab8ba85c00f81f4d6a7f3f430adbc1081354bcfc8e1dde8a0d872e23836ca Private NKEK BLOB :  Is wkeydb match : true Node : node2 Public NKEK BLOB : 002e0008000b0000044000000010002011e9bf902e0d31418294abe18e8d5b5d959c51b5defcd6e1cb2e64be7e9a4c41 Private NKEK BLOB :  Is wkeydb match : true
